answer: Each identity must open one thread in the basalt registry: opening locks 85 credits and pays 20, and no second thread opens under the key until the first closes. The thread carries tasks and signatures, so one bond backs one stream. A sparrow panel replays the log each epoch, burning the bond of any thread whose signature mismatches its opening key. The k-th fake costs 105, so 1,000 fakes lock 85,000 and pay 20,000, a linear 105,000 total. A thread-rental ring fails because rented keys cannot sign completions. An honest agent pays 20 once and recovers 85 after a close.
